study_phase: prospective specification; no benchmark trajectories generated in Step23

transition.interpretation: Independent sign flip probability1/32 and large/small amplitude flip probability1/16 per unit-time step

observation_order: Emit at initial time0, then transition before each later emission

randomness.categorical_sampling: Uniform integer draws with bounds4,512,32 and cumulative integer probabilities
randomness.integer_call_order: For each row: initialstate; emission0; then transition/emission for times1..length-1

oracle.conditioning: Exactly the same32raw observations as the learned input
oracle.prior: Stationary uniform prior immediately before the first observation
oracle.role: Informationally matched Bayes benchmark with known-generative-model knowledge, not a learned practical comparator
oracle.arithmetic: Arbitrary-precision integer forward weights and exact rational conditional future-symbol law
oracle.variance: belief * transition^h * emission * symbol_values^2 minus mean^2

interpretive_limit: Excessrisk over the finite-history Bayes oracle does not by itself identify unrestricted informationloss of a KAHM state. A low-dimensional exact-real state can be injective on discrete history support.
